title: planar curve/curve tangent/overlap STILL drops a filled region (1334 fix incomplete — only covered coincident same-arc, not distinct tangent circles)
description:
REOPENS the originally-filed data loss of task 1334. The 9188b31 fix ("handle coincident curves") did NOT fix the curve/curve repro that 1334 was filed for — it fixed a DIFFERENT, adjacent problem (the stroked-oval REBUILD where a fill loop and its own coincident stroke loop trace the SAME arc). The fix's intersectCurveCurve coincidentOverlap fast-path only engages when two quadratics trace the SAME path over a substantial span; it does NOT engage for two DISTINCT tangent/overlapping circles (they trace different arcs, touching over zero or a short span). So intersectCurveCurve.recurse STILL floods the arrangement with spurious crossings and one or both filled regions leak to the unbounded face. Task 1334 was marked done (fb4fb8e) on the strength of the stroked-oval pick test + the merge-drawing oracles, neither of which exercises two distinct tangent/overlapping CURVED fills — the exact raster-oracle GUARD the 1334 acceptance criteria asked for was never added, which is why the regression slipped through.

ROOT CAUSE: same unpinned/flood class as 1332 but in the curve/curve transversal path. intersectCurveCurve (packages/core/src/engine/planar/intersect.ts:161, the `recurse` subdivision at :287) emits a flood of near-duplicate crossings when two curve bboxes overlap heavily near tangency; the arrangement shatters (he count 16 -> 38..202), face tracing collapses, regions leak to unbounded. The 1332 seg/seg fix (pin the snapped crossing through chopEdge/splitLocal) and the 1334 coincident-overlap fast-path both leave this transversal/near-tangent curve flood unaddressed.

DETERMINISTIC PURE-KERNEL REPRO (raster oracle = acceptance gate, raster-oracle.ts SS=4):
  circle(cx,cy,r) = quadratic-4-arc disk; controls at corner box (cx+/-r, cy+/-r); closed, filled.
  RED=circle(50,60,30); BLUE=circle(50+dx,60,30); merge via buildArrangementFromShapes([RED,BLUE]); read back planarShapeToShape; rasterize folded vs z-order ground truth; 200x120.
  At HEAD fb4fb8e:
    dx=62 (gap)      diff=0     he=16   both colors 3080/3080  OK
    dx=60 (TANGENT)  diff=6160  he=202  foldedColors=NONE      BUG (BOTH circles dropped)
    dx=58 (overlap2) diff=3044  he=56   BLUE only (RED gone)   BUG
    dx=55            diff=6034  he=38   NONE (both gone)       BUG
    dx=50            diff=2773  he=36   BLUE only              BUG
    dx=45            diff=0     he=24   both                   OK
    dx=40            diff=5390  he=40   NONE (both gone)       BUG
    dx=30            diff=3     he=44   both                   OK (deep overlap recovers)
  Regime-dependent (like 1332): specific separations corrupt while neighbours are clean; the dropped color flips. Note dx=60 is WORSE than the original 1334 report (which said BLUE-only, 6150 red): at HEAD BOTH circles drop (he flood 202). Verified the fix did not regress this (pre-9188b31 and post are identical at dx=60: diff 6160, NONE), so this is unfixed, not newly broken.

Also confirmed (NOT this task's primary): SEG/CURVE transversal cut through a curved fill is CORRECT (rect through circle at x=110/119 keeps both regions). Only an EXACT single-point tangency of a straight edge to a curve apex degenerates (rect left edge at x=120 exactly tangent to circle cx=80 r=40: bounded faces 1, red disk absorbed). That is a measure-zero corner case, far less severe than the wide curve/curve regime above; mentioning for completeness but the headline data loss is curve/curve.

FIX DIRECTION (mirror 1332): make intersectCurveCurve's transversal `recurse` path collapse a near-tangent crossing CLUSTER to a single PINNED snapped vertex (the curve analogue of the seg/seg pin), and feed that pinned point through chopEdge/splitLocal so both curves split at the EXACT same vertex (already pinned for the params it receives — the problem is recurse emits MANY params, not one). The coincidentOverlap fast-path stays for true same-arc coincidence; the gap is the distinct-curve tangent/near-tangent flood.

ACCEPTANCE: ADD the curve/curve raster-oracle GUARD that 1334 asked for (two curved fills across a dx sweep gap..deep-overlap, merged read-back raster diff 0 vs z-order ground truth, both same-color and different-color), to packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/planar-adversarial.test.ts alongside the 1332 angled-cut family. Currently NO committed test covers this.

Found by autonomous QA re-verification of task 1334 at HEAD fb4fb8e (golden hash 9d09912df4727d0c unchanged; core 5498 pass + 2 pre-existing flash8-empty.fla ENOENT; swf 1466 pass; all committed planar suites 116 pass).
